question.text: A PM managing a global FI portfolio hedges USD bond holdings into INR using:

explanation.text: The Logic: Currency Swap exchanges INR-denominated for USD-denominated cash flows (principal + interest), mitigating USD/INR fluctuations on global bonds. The Trap: IRS hedges rate risk, not FX; CDS for credit; equity futures irrelevant. Cross-Exam Context: I (Currency Derivatives) covers; XXI-B applies to PM. Manager's Pro-Tip: Rolling short FX forwards is cheaper and more flexible than currency swaps for short-horizon hedges — match hedge tenor to investment tenor.
